figures.name: Marduk

ability.name: Enuma Elish
ability.description: Destroy one chaos/dark enemy completely; create a new ally from their remains at half stats.

figures.description: Supreme god of Babylon who defeated Tiamat and fashioned the cosmos from her body, the greatest of gods.

figures.name: Tiamat

ability.name: Primordial Dragon
ability.description: Transform: become an 11-headed dragon dealing 3 damage to all enemies per turn.

figures.description: Primordial salt ocean and mother of all gods who rose in fury against her divine children and was slain by Marduk.

figures.name: Ishtar

ability.name: Seven Gates Descent
ability.description: Strip one enemy of their armor and all buffs as Ishtar descended through seven gates.

figures.description: Passionate goddess of love and war whose descent to the underworld caused all desire to cease on earth.

figures.name: Apsu

ability.name: Primordial Deep
ability.description: Restore all abilities that were sealed or silenced to all allies.

figures.description: The primordial sweet water and co-creator of the universe who was slain by Ea before his own plan could succeed.

figures.name: Nanna-Sin

ability.name: Crescent Moon
ability.description: All timing-based enemy abilities are delayed by 1 turn.

figures.description: The Babylonian moon god whose crescent measures time and whose wisdom governs fate and divination.

figures.name: Shamash

ability.name: All-Seeing Eye
ability.description: No enemy can use hidden, disguised or deceptive abilities while Shamash is in play.

figures.description: The sun god of absolute justice who gave the laws to Hammurabi and sees every human action from the sky.

figures.name: Nergal (Babylonian)

ability.name: King of the Dead
ability.description: All enemies lose 2 defense from plague fear while Nergal is in play.

figures.description: The Babylonian god of pestilence who became king of the underworld by overpowering Ereshkigal.

figures.name: Kingu

ability.name: Blood of the Slain
ability.description: When this card is destroyed, its blood creates a new ally with 5 in all stats (humans).

figures.description: Tiamat's champion who wore the Tablet of Destinies; his blood was used by Marduk to create humanity.

figures.name: Nabu

ability.name: Divine Stylus
ability.description: Grant all allies the knowledge of one enemy hidden ability.

figures.description: God of scribes and writing, son of Marduk, whose power of the written word preserves divine wisdom.

figures.name: Girra

ability.name: Sacred Flame
ability.description: Deal 4 fire damage; purify one ally of all curse effects through fire.

figures.description: Babylonian fire god who both destroys and purifies, worshipped for his transformative burning power.

figures.name: Anunnaki

ability.name: Seven Judges
ability.description: All enemies are subject to divine judgment: the strongest enemy loses 2 of their highest stat.

figures.description: The great Anunnaki gods who sit as judges of the dead in the underworld, determining the fate of souls.

figures.name: Adad

ability.name: Storm Omen
ability.description: Deal 3 storm damage to all enemies; predict next enemy action (revealed to player).

figures.description: God of storms and rain whose thunderbolts deliver divine messages and whose omens are read in weather patterns.

figures.name: Pazuzu

ability.name: Southwest Fever Wind
ability.description: Inflict fever on one enemy: they lose 2 power and 2 defense for 2 turns.

figures.description: King of the wind demons whose terrifying image paradoxically wards off other demons from pregnant women.

figures.name: Asag

ability.name: Mountain Plague
ability.description: Turn one enemy to stone: immobilize them and reduce their stats to 3 for 1 turn.

figures.description: Monstrous stone demon born of sky and earth whose touch causes disease and who fights from within mountain boulders.

figures.name: Lamashtu

ability.name: Child Fever
ability.description: Inflict poison on one enemy; that enemy cannot heal or regenerate for 2 turns.

figures.description: Half-lion half-bird demoness who kills children, causes nightmares and spreads disease — feared above all demons.

figures.name: Gilgamesh Epic Bull

ability.name: Celestial Rampage
ability.description: Charge all enemies dealing 3 damage each; create tremor disrupting next enemy turn.

figures.description: The divine bull of the Babylonian epic whose destruction by Gilgamesh and Enkidu angered the gods of heaven.

figures.name: Etana

ability.name: Eagle Flight
ability.description: This card can reach any position on the field and attack from above ignoring ground defenses.

figures.description: First king after the flood who rode an eagle toward heaven to find the plant of birth for his childless queen.

figures.name: Sarpanitu

ability.name: Star of Birth
ability.description: When any ally is summoned, grant them +2 to their lowest stat.

figures.description: Beloved consort of Marduk who shone as the morning star and whose name means the Shining One.

figures.name: Imdugud/Anzu (Babylonian)

ability.name: Storm Wing
ability.description: Deal 4 air damage to all enemies and remove one buff from each.

figures.description: The great lion-headed storm eagle who created tempests with his wings and stole the divine laws.

figures.name: Oannes

ability.name: Gift of Civilization
ability.description: Grant all allies +2 wisdom; remove all barbarism debuffs from the field.

figures.description: Fish-man who emerged from the sea each day to teach humanity all arts of civilization, returning to water at night.
